bio: Greetings class of 2029! I am so excited to welcome you all to campus! My name is Taylor Diggs (she/her/hers). I was born in NYC, raised in Jersey but will forever be a New Yorker. In 2021, I graduated from The Citadel, The Military College of South Carolina. In college, I played Division I Soccer, studied Political Science and Spanish. This year, I will be beginning my second year at Harvard Law School and second term as a Proctor. I’ve loved finding community within Harvard University and am eager to help you all do the same! Most of all, during advising meetings, I have loved learning about my students’ aspirations and devising paths that will leave them happy, healthy and ready to be the change they wish to see in the world.
